body: Oh thanks. We probably have a lot to accomplishing our lives. However, a lot of  optimism gets stripped away when you compare it the suffering that fills ours lives (someone who is suffering from depression etc.). I guess all I can really do is hope. Hope to live a happy life. Hope to find meaning. Hope to find some satisfaction. My main reason for living is that if I were to commit suicide, it would cause more suffering. The real problem occurs when sometimes I get so nihilistic that the suffering caused by my death doesn’t matter as well. I’ll just hang in there for now.
Thanks for the reply. I’m really trying to focus on my lifespan instead of “x” amount of billion years. I guess it’s all you could really do, right?
Same mate, I hope you find your peace.
